recentItems.title: సంగారెడ్డిలో అసంపూర్తి మార్కెట్.. పిచ్చిమొక్కలతో అధ్వాన్నంగా పరిసరాలు || Ground Report
recentItems.description:
The integrated market project in Sangareddy, planned at an estimated cost of ₹9.30 crore for vegetable, meat and fish sales, remains incomplete after construction reportedly stalled midway. Residents continue to face difficulties due to the lack of a proper market facility. Watch Prashanth’s ground report.
